encounters.scenario: A salesperson retries after the customer declines additional purchases, and the customer finally accepts a smaller, lower-priced laptop sleeve.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good evening. Looking for a laptop today?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, the Lenovo IdeaPad Slim 3, the 16 GB model. You quoted ₹45,990 on the phone.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Correct, same price. We have a sealed piece in grey. Shall I bring it out?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, please. I'll take that one.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Before I make the bill, would you like the two-year extended warranty? It's ₹3,499 extra, over the standard one-year warranty.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No, the standard warranty is enough. I'm already spending more than I planned.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: All right, no extended warranty. Do you need a laptop backpack, though? This padded one is ₹1,499.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No, no bag. I have a backpack already. Please keep the extra expense down.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Understood. If your existing bag doesn't have padding, there's just this basic sleeve for ₹399. It fits inside your bag. Would you like that instead?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Actually, mine doesn't have a laptop section. Fine, add the ₹399 sleeve, but nothing else.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Certainly. Only the laptop and this sleeve. Your total is ₹46,389, including taxes.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Okay. Can I pay by UPI?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, the QR code is here. We'll check the laptop with you before you leave and put the sleeve in the carry bag.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Done, payment sent. Yes, let's check it once before packing.

encounters.notes: The salesperson proactively offers an extended warranty, then a backpack after rejection, then a lower-priced sleeve after another rejection. Only the sleeve is accepted. Confirming the requested laptop, billing, payment, and packing are not upsell attempts.

encounters.scenario: Customer office use ke liye laptop lene aata hai. Salesperson discounted laptop bag aur wireless mouse bundle offer karta hai, jo customer accept kar leta hai.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Hello sir, kya dekh rahe hain aaj?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Office ke liye laptop chahiye. Excel, video calls, bas normal kaam hai. Budget forty-five thousand tak hai.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji, yeh model dekh lijiye. 8 GB RAM, 512 GB SSD hai. Aapke kaam ke liye theek rahega, aur price hai 42,990.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Battery kitni chal jaati hai? Kabhi meeting mein charging point nahi milta.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Normal office use mein around five to six hours expect kar sakte hain. Video calls zyada hongi toh thoda kam chalegi.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Theek hai, yehi laptop kar dijiye.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sir, iske saath laptop bag aur wireless mouse ka bundle bhi hai. Dono saath lenge toh extra 1,499 lagenge, alag lene se 999 bachenge. Office le jaane mein bag bhi kaam aa jayega. Add kar doon?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Achha, alag-alag kitne ke hain? Aur bag mein laptop fit toh aayega?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Bag 1,499 ka aur mouse 999 ka hai, total 2,498. Laptop ke saath bundle price 1,499 hai. Yeh dekhiye, laptop ismein properly fit ho raha hai, padding bhi hai.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Haan, bag toh waise bhi chahiye tha. Theek hai, dono add kar do bundle mein.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Ji sir. Laptop, bag aur wireless mouse mila ke total 44,489 ho gaya. Bill kis naam se banaun?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Rohit Sharma. Payment UPI se kar sakta hoon?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Bilkul sir, yahan QR scan kar lijiye. Main tab tak bill aur packing ready kar deta hoon.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Ho gaya payment. Bill bag mein rakh dena, please.

encounters.notes: Turn 7 is the sole proactive upsell: a discounted bag-and-mouse bundle beyond the requested laptop. Turn 9 answers the customer's pricing and fit questions rather than introducing another upsell. Customer accepts the bundle in turn 10.

encounters.scenario: A salesperson and customer exchange casual small talk about the rain before a quick wired-mouse purchase, with one mouse-pad cross-sell.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good evening, sir. Rain has finally slowed down, no?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Yes, but the road outside is still flooded. Took me twenty minutes from the signal.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: That junction gets blocked every time. Did you get parking nearby?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Luckily, one spot was empty just outside.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Good, otherwise parking itself takes another ten minutes. Tell me, what were you looking for?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Just a basic wired USB mouse for my office laptop. Around five hundred rupees.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: This one is ₹449, including GST. Standard USB connection, two buttons and a scroll wheel.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Fine, that's all I need. I'll take it.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Would you like a mouse pad along with it? This plain one is ₹99 extra.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: No, thanks. I already have one at my desk.

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Sure, only the mouse. ₹449 total. Card or UPI?

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: UPI. I'll scan this code here?

turns.speaker: S1
turns.text: Yes, that one. Payment received, sir. Here's your mouse and bill.

turns.speaker: S2
turns.text: Thank you. Let me leave before the rain starts again.

encounters.notes: The opening small talk contains no selling. Offering the requested mouse within budget is request fulfillment. The only upsell attempt is the optional ₹99 mouse pad in turn 9; the salesperson accepts the refusal without another push.
